K0 asymptotics give P(σ1 ξ1η1>z)~√(σ1/(2πz))exp(−z/σ1); independent R exponential tilt contributes 2/√π and tight offmode continuous path. Conditional leading Gaussian factors balance with two equal signs, producing B/√z→±(2/√π)sin(πu/2) in C[0,1]. Age posterior has exponent Φ_x(s)=rs+πx/(4Λs), unique saddle s_x=√(πx/(4Λr)), second derivative 2r/s_x and width h_x=√(s_x/(2r)); Laplace localization with near-leading tail gives standardized N(0,1). The scaling identity multiplies the path by √Λ and squaring continuously gives deterministic 4Λ/π sin²(πu/2) uniformly.
